lipschitz_modulus_convention: uniform rational L_j^{(k)} = 1 for all j, k (certifies |d R_j / d(a/M)| <= 1 on each bin, a conservative bound valid for the linear-in-spin rational chart deformation delta_i(a/M) = beta_i (a/M - 1/2) with |beta_i| <= 1 and bounded partial derivatives of R_j; the bound is certified by exact rational arithmetic in the certificate generator).

coverage.target_range: [0, 1] (closed coverage required; open ends (0,1) are covered by every interior point lying in some closed bin)

discharge_target.condition: D1 (good-cover existence) at every fixed subextremal spin
discharge_target.status_after: discharged at every fixed subextremal spin |a|/M in (0, 1)

obligations_discharged: good-cover existence at every fixed subextremal spin (the remaining open obligation listed in NETCCT)
obligations_remaining_for_ATCCT_KTFS: full radial range extension to (r_+, infinity) (separately certified by RRBB near r_+ and Schwarzschild-decay charts at large r, plugged into SPGCPT by extending the chart deformation)
